raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Results-driven Business Analyst with 7 years in global cards
and payments, specializing in GPP and ISO 20022 migration.
Expertise in requirements gathering, stakeholder
management, and delivering solutions across complex
payment ecosystems. Experience in Retail Banking focusing
on transaction lifecycle management and scalable,
customer-centric solutions.
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Oct 2022 — Current
FINASTRA, Pune, India
Led end-to-end implementation of GPP (Global
Payments Platform), ensuring seamless integration with
core banking systems.
Hands-on experience in ISO 20022 migration, including
message mapping, validation, and compliance with
SWIFT standards.
Hands-on expertise in SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area)
payment processing, ensuring compliance with European
regulatory standards.
Strong knowledge of digital payments, cross-border
transactions, and real-time payment systems.
Expertise in transaction lifecycle management – from
initiation, authorization, clearing, to settlement.
Expertise in developing jars in internal interface for MX
conversion.
Conducted requirement gathering, gap analysis, and
functional specification creation for global payments

through counseling sessions, directly contributing to
revenue targets and platform expansion.
May 2019 — Oct 2020
Deputy Manager
ICICI Bank, Ahmedabad
Developed and implemented strategies for top-tier
customer service.
Oversaw branch operation and workflow for consistency.
Managed operational tasks and transactions at the
branch
PROJECTS
Successfully contributed to the CHIPS ISO Migration
project in collaboration with HSBC, BRCL, and MANT
Bank, ensuring smooth transition of payment messaging
standards to ISO 20022.
Additionally worked on the FED ISO Migration initiative
with the same set of banks, focusing on harmonizing
cross-border payment formats and enhancing
interoperability.
Currently leading and managing CBPR+, CHIPS, and FED
2026 regulatory change implementations across HSBC,
BRCL, and MANT Bank, ensuring compliance with
evolving global payment regulations.
Responsibilities included requirement gathering, impact
analysis, stakeholder coordination, and end-to-end
delivery of migration activities, while mitigating
operational risks and ensuring business continuity.
